rationale: The column holds the classification symbol itself, drawn from whichever system the sibling classification_type names (IPC and CPC for patents, Nice for trade marks, Locarno for designs, UPOV and botanical names for plant breeder's rights). supersedes_rationale: The earlier review had no Appendix 15. IP Australia publishes the equivalent as the IP RAPID data dictionary, and the underlying data is open, so both the definition and real values are available.

value_domain: Simplified classification area: WIPO technology field (patents), Nice class symbol (trade marks), first two digits of the Locarno class (designs), plant group (plant breeder's rights)
value_source: IP Australia, IP RAPID Data Dictionary, Table 8 application-classification; distinct values read from the published IP RAPID application_classification.csv
rationale: The BLADE description is the IP RAPID dictionary's wording verbatim. All 100 distinct values were tallied over the full published extract. Patents give the 35 WIPO technology-concordance fields as '<number>_<field name>' plus 99_unknown (concordance itself published by WIPO at https://www.wipo.int/documents/2948119/3215563/wipo_ipc_technology.pdf); trade marks give a bare Nice class number 1-45; designs give a two-digit Locarno class, zero-padded, so '01'-'09' are unambiguously designs while '10'-'32' are shared with Nice; PBR gives eight plant groups (ornamentals, fruit_crops, field_crops_(cereals), field_crops_(non-cereals), vegetable_crops, forage_crops, amenity_grasses_and_turf, fungi). An empty string occurs on 95,732 rows. The companion coarse_classification_area takes 10 values.
evidence_quote: Classification area provides a simplification of the IP right system
supersedes_rationale: The earlier review had no Appendix 16. The IP RAPID dictionary defines the field and the open data gives the full observed domain.

value_domain: IP Australia party role (role of a party on an IP right)
value_source: IP Australia, IP RAPID Data Dictionary, Table 11 'Party role definitions & categories by right type'; distinct values read from the published IP RAPID party_activity.csv
rationale: BLADE table 34 is the IP RAPID Party table and the BLADE description, including the note that a party can hold several roles concurrently, is the IP RAPID dictionary's wording verbatim. The 51 values listed are every distinct party_role in the published extract (12,397,185 rows), ordered by frequency: agent 4,251,049, applicant 4,154,490, owner 2,261,549, patentee 789,750. The dictionary's Table 11 documents 49 roles by right type; it omits four that occur in the data (agent_for_opposition, applicant_being_opposed, breeder, qualified_person) and lists two that do not (designer, thd_pty_inq). Roles roll up to nine party_role_category values: applicant, applicant_agent, opposition, opposition_agent, other, other_agent, non_use_applicant, mortgagee, licensee.
evidence_quote: The role of the party associated with this IP right
supersedes_rationale: The earlier review had no Appendix 20. IP Australia's IP RAPID dictionary is the appendix's public equivalent, and the open data confirms the domain.
